children: Cayson Acquisition entered a Termination Agreement on Sep 2, 2026 to mutually end its Jul 11, 2025 Agreement and Plan of Merger with Mango Financial Group and related parties. Under the terms, Mango will pay certain company expenses previously agreed under the merger, and Cayson will issue a promissory note for the same amount, payable without interest upon completion of an initial business combination. If Cayson lacks cash at repayment, the note may be converted at the company's option into units at $10.00 per unit, matching the private units from its IPO; prior notes to Mango will be similarly convertible. The SPAC will resume its search for a new business combination target.
